title: NPC Resetting Movement Route across Event Pages

posts.author: Alt_Elrond
posts.body: Hey everyone, I'm still fairly new to rpg maker mz, but I'm struggling with an npc. I set their movement route to move along a path in a circle using the custom autonomous movement command and everything is fine there. The issue is that once the player talks to them and they move to a new event page, that they completely reset where they are at in the path to the beginning and end up making that same circular movement on a different part of the map. Is there a way to make it so that they continue from whatever step they were at in the route when the event pages switch?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: You could use Visustella's Event and movement core to use coordinates instead of fixed steps. That way, even if your event is on a different page, the moveroute would make the npc move to the coordinates designated instead of just restarting the circle wherever they're currently at.
